Hi Samantha / Carlos —

Great to meet you both on Friday. Per our discovery, we put together a draft mutual action plan (attached) with milestone windows and recommended owner assignments so we can move from POC to production in a predictable cadence. High level:

- Proposed cutover windows: week of Apr 19 (pilot) or week of Apr 26 (full rollout).
- Key milestones: integration test, performance ramp, security review, final sign-off.
- Owners: Loomly infra (you), Redwood implementation lead (Mina), Integration QA (Marissa).

Action needed: please review the attached MAP and confirm your preferred cutover slot plus any blackout dates for April. If Apr 26 looks good, we will schedule the pre-cutover test week (Apr 12–16) and lock owners to the RACI.

Attachments: Loomly_MAP_v1.2.xlsx, Cutover_Window_Options.pdf

If helpful I can send a one-page owner sprint and a DocuSign for the SOW once dates are confirmed.

Team —

Samantha confirmed Apr 26 as the preferred rollout week and requested an early smoke test (Apr 5 window) + explicit rollback window and performance SLAs. Please see the short checklist and owners below — I'm pulling this into our implementation board after we close the slot.

Proposed sprint & owners:
- Pre-cutover smoke test (Apr 5–6): Owner — Marissa Cole (Integration QA)
- Integration validation & security checklist (Apr 7–16): Owner — Soojin Lee (Security/Compliance)
- Pre-rollout performance ramp (Apr 19–23): Owner — Jordan Blake (AE / coordination)
- Cutover & monitoring (Apr 26–30): Owner — Mina Haddad (Implementation Lead)
- Rollback window: first 48 hours post-cutover with automated fallback to replica cluster; owner — Operations (TBD)

Immediate asks from owners:
1) Marissa — confirm QA resource headcount and required test accounts by EOD Thu 3/18.
2) Soojin — share the security checklist items that must be satisfied before Apr 16 and any doc requests for Loomly.
3) Jordan — finalize SOW/DocuSign link once Loomly confirms Apr 26.

Risks to flag:
- External vendor (analytics pipeline) may require schema changes during the integration test — we need an owner from Loomly to sign off on schema freeze by Apr 2.
- Calendar blackout: Loomly noted high availability maintenance on Apr 22; we should avoid that day for heavy tests.

I'll attach the MAP (v1.2) to the board and create a short owner sprint doc. Anything else to add before we send the updated MAP back to Loomly?

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
